description: A skid road and rehabilitated trail off of Bugaboo Creek Road at 29.5km leads to alpine basins and extensive views of the Bugaboos from Grizzly Ridge. Avalanche hazards. ATVs prohibited.
directions: From highway 95 in Brisco, go west on Brisco Road 4.9km. Take the left fork, and in 1.5km turn right. In 700m, continue straight onto Bugaboo Creek Road. Travel 11.2km, and turn right to stay on Bugaboo creek road for another 17.1km. This should be just past the 29km marker. The trail goes northwest from here. Bugaboo Falls rec site is another 4km further down this road.
title: Rocky Point Trail
